name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.machine.view.MachineScanResultActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this page in a machine-scanning flow. It hosts results for the selected machine type and carries the cashback amount back to the caller.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes the machine scan and result-selection flow.
